route_registry.generated_layer_policy: 仅上报点击事件，不决定页面、不读取 BLE/NVS/service/watch_state。

routes.route_shell_slot_01: resolve binding_present and ble_connected after a fresh fact snapshot
routes.route_shell_slot_02: use 02-02 only for physical BLE disconnection; selftest lock keeps 02-01 disabled
routes.route_shell_slot_03: use 03-02 only for physical BLE disconnection; selftest lock keeps 03-01 disabled
routes.route_shell_slot_04: payment lock has priority over ordinary alerts within the main shell; full settings hierarchy remains accessible
routes.route_binding_entry: open the BLE on-demand screen from an unbound home state
routes.route_ble_reconnect_success: refresh all facts and preserve the current shell slot when allowed
routes.route_payment_success: refresh all facts and resolve slot 01; never hardcode 01-01
routes.route_payment_lock: force 04-03 or 04-04 only within the main shell while payment remains unresolved; preserve the full settings hierarchy
routes.route_selftest_lock_overlay: disable gear, assist, all four mode controls and poweroff without changing connected page identity; preserve pager, swipe and page navigation
routes.route_settings_children: open device info or maintenance as on-demand screens
routes.route_maintenance_children: open selftest flow or create the clear-binding modal on demand
routes.route_ble_flow: resolve empty, scanning, candidates, connecting and failure from BLE facts
routes.route_binding_success: refresh all facts before resolving the destination
routes.route_selftest_flow: resolve progress, retry and manual states from selftest facts
routes.route_selftest_result: resolve completed result and retry entry from selftest facts
routes.route_selftest_gps_context: resolve default, submitting and failed GPS context states
routes.route_selftest_retry: retry only the selected failed item
routes.route_clear_binding_modal: create modal on click; destroy it after cancel or completion
routes.route_back_to_shell: return to the preserved shell slot through phase 3 binding
routes.route_back_to_settings: release current temporary screen and return to settings
routes.route_back_to_maintenance: release current temporary screen and return to maintenance
routes.route_back_to_selftest_result: release retry detail and return to selftest result
